instructions: How much of the operator's intent can be read from this message alone, without guessing what they mean?

options.label: actionable
options.criterion: the message names a concrete task, file, command, or question the agent can act on directly

options.label: partial
options.criterion: the message states a goal but omits one or more details the agent will have to assume

options.label: cannot_tell
options.criterion: the message is too short, vague, or off-topic to extract any concrete intent
